name: accordion
description: An accordion is a vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each contain a title and a content area.

documentBlocks.content: An accordion is a vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each contain a title and a content area.

Single vs. multiple expansion.

By default, only one accordion item may be expanded at a time. However, the component can be configured to allow multiple items to remain open simultaneously.

Title wrapping.

Accordion titles wrap automatically if they exceed the available width.

Optional actions.

An optional action button or switch can be placed on the trailing edge of an accordion item to support contextual interactions.

Progressive disclosure.

Accordions are effective for organizing large amounts of related content within a limited space. They help users stay focused by revealing information only when it's needed, making them ideal for scenarios where not all content needs to be visible at once.

documentBlocks.dont: Avoid using accordions when users are likely to read all the content in one go, as they can introduce unnecessary clicks and hinder the user experience. For complex or deeply nested information structures, consider alternative components such as tree views or tabs to maintain clarity and ease of navigation

implementations.notes: Spectrum 2 web component custom element: swc-accordion.

label.description: The text label displayed for the accordion item.

content.description: The content shown when the accordion item is expanded.

isExpanded.description: Whether the accordion item is expanded by default.

hasSwitch.description: If true, the accordion item includes a switch.

hasActionButton.description: If true, the accordion item includes an action button.

isMultiple.description: If true, multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.
